payload.text: hv, 2 Nov, first-hand in vc's session, on vc's plan for 2.14.9 (decision 86): "Go with your recommendations." So (i) R2, bin/devbin release check, and R3, bin/devbin release --patch --dry-run, run before the cut, read-only, which lifts watch-out 22's "no dry run" for them; (ii) R1, the tools/post-cut 2.14.8 smoke, runs; (iii) the version is 2.14.9; (iv) hv pushes main before the cut, and vc reads its CI green first. ST0031/04 (utilz-dc, S: tests.yml on candidate/**, post-cut in 0.1.19's shape) goes ahead on vc's chain, every run booked at the desk, then hv's cut with the freeze. Peers read this decision at pickup; cc and dc record no copy.
